content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "That's not a career pivot, that's a debt you're trying to pay back.

Ten years of making other people's companies efficient and the thing you actually want to make efficient is the one your grandfather got squeezed by. That's a sharper reason than most people starting in food have.

What's the piece you keep picturing fixing, the part where the value disappears, pricing, storage, logistics, who gets to sell direct?"

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
